news.title: Missing World Cup soccer? Ted Lasso Season 4 is giving football fans their fix
news.lede: The World Cup ended a few weeks ago. For plenty of fans, ordinary life still hasn't quite recovered. Across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, creators are posting nostalgic edits, empty stadiums and montages of the month that seemed to disappear almost as quickly as it arrived. In the comments, people are talking about missing the daily rhythm of matches, the crowds, the travel and even the strange feeling of having half the world watching the same thing at the same time.

news.title: India’s World Cup quest needs more than big friendlies
news.lede: NEW DELHI, Aug 16: India’s dream of qualifying for the FIFA World Cup remains a distant prospect, with the country’s footballing structure still facing fundamental challenges despite years of investment and ambitious plans for development. Rather than pointing towards an immediate breakthrough at the global level, the All India Football Federation’s (AIFF) own long-term roadmap…. Rather than pointing towards an immediate breakthrough at the global level, the All India Football Federation’s (AIFF) own long-term roadmap suggests that building a system capable of consistently producing World Cup-calibre players is a process that could stretch towards 2047.
